# README banner and plugin icon

Both pictures were generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple. The same prompt, size and seed give the same picture.

## banner.jpg

1536x640, seed 4127, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. Picked from four seeds (4127, 90311, 551872, 2768031).

> a single chunky round glossy red push button on a small dark pedestal, pressed down hard so it squashes wide and flat, bright golden sparks and small colorful star-shaped bursts spraying outward from its rim, streaks of light, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted color palette, deep plum and teal background as one smooth graded wash of color, detailed, playful

## ../../.claude-plugin/icon.png

1024x1024, seed 700213, saved as rendered. Picked from four seeds (3301, 48812, 700213, 1599427).
